messages.subject: RE: Project Kestrel - Subscription Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Please find attached our mark-up of the Subscription Agreement (v2, redline against your v1). The principal points for the Investor are: (1) completion to occur within 20 business days rather than 30; (2) the warranty liability cap to be increased to 150% of the subscription amount; and (3) the warranty claim notice period extended to 24 months. Other changes are minor drafting.

Happy to discuss.

Deepa Kovac
Birchall Stone LLP
